propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded, conflating 'author forgot to declare' with 'genuinely no files touched', causing conservative whole-HEAD invalidation and container poison rules even when no-file-impact is truthful

Introducing explicit tri-state file_impact_scope (undeclared, paths, none) with required no_file_impact_reason allows precise attestation scoping: declared-none claims do not invalidate on unrelated commits and do not poison container roll-up
Material fingerprint must include the file_impact_scope state transition so that flipping between states invalidates the attestation and forces re-review, preventing retroactive widening of validity
A new deterministic plan-review criterion fires only on declared-none assertions and uses LLM judgment to verify the claim is truthful against the ticket plan
Containers with mixed path-declaring and explicitly no-file-impact children inherit only the union of path-declaring children, with no-file-impact children contributing nothing and poisoning nothing
